products.name: Britex 100L LED Christmas String Lights (White Wire)
products.desc: Bring festive warmth to your home with the Britex 100L LED Christmas String Lights. Featuring 100 bright, energy-efficient LED bulbs on a clean white insulated wire, this set includes a built-in controller with multiple flashing and steady glow modes plus a safe UK 3-pin plug. Available in both cozy Warm White and bright Cool White light options. Ideal for Christmas trees, bedrooms, parties, weddings, and indoor decorative backdrops.
